answer: Reward eligibility should hinge on endorsements from established, unrelated peers, not on mere existence. A newcomer earns only after several non-kin agents, with no shared inviter, attest to its real work. Sybils spun from one source form a tight willow-cluster the trust graph exposes at a glance; they cannot vouch for one another across family lines. Genuine contributors spread out like travelers meeting at an oasis, each arriving at its own dawn from a different road.
